body.ratingBasis: Зохиогчийн CF difficulty-ийн баримжаа; full task-д хамаарна. Shortest path-д багтаж болох edge-үүдийг ялгаж, тэр DAG дээр нэмэлт мэдээлэл нэгтгэнэ.

body.title: JOI 2019 — Coin Collecting
body.lesson: Зөөх үйлдлүүдийн нийлбэр өртгийг мөр, баганын тэнцвэрийн нөхцөлтэй харьцуулж бодно.
body.ratingBasis: Зохиогчийн CF difficulty-ийн баримжаа; full task-д хамаарна. Зөөх үйлдлүүдийн нийлбэр өртгийг мөр, баганын тэнцвэрийн нөхцөлтэй харьцуулж бодно.

body.lesson: Хугацаа, багтаамжийн хязгаарын нөлөөг жижиг жишээн дээр ялгаж, зөв дарааллаар боловсруулахыг судална.
body.ratingBasis: Зохиогчийн CF difficulty-ийн баримжаа; full task-д хамаарна. Хугацаа, багтаамжийн хязгаарын нөлөөг жижиг жишээн дээр ялгаж, зөв дарааллаар боловсруулахыг судална.

body.title: JOI 2021 — Growing Vegetables is Fun 4
body.lesson: Хоёр талаас нь тавигдах шаардлагыг тус тусад нь гаргаж, хамтад нь хангах хамгийн бага өртгийг олно.
body.ratingBasis: Зохиогчийн CF difficulty-ийн баримжаа; full task-д хамаарна. Хоёр талаас нь тавигдах шаардлагыг тус тусад нь гаргаж, хамтад нь хангах хамгийн бага өртгийг олно.

body.title: Railroad Trip
body.ratingBasis: Recognizing travel counts as interval updates avoids simulating each route;the remaining minimum-cost choice is direct;rough CF1500.
body.priorityReason: A clear real-world use of range-add frequency counting,followed by independent per-edge cost choices.
body.learningObjective: A clear real-world use of range-add frequency counting,followed by independent per-edge cost choices.

body.title: Cake 2
body.ratingBasis: Circular interval duplication and turn-dependent transitions at quadratic scale;rough CF2000.
body.priorityReason: Good interval-DP practice on a circle with one deterministic greedy opponent;clarifies whose turn belongs in a state.
body.learningObjective: Good interval-DP practice on a circle with one deterministic greedy opponent;clarifies whose turn belongs in a state.

body.title: JOI Park
body.ratingBasis: Distance-based activation and incremental edge-cost accounting require an extra modelling step after Dijkstra;rough CF2000.
body.priorityReason: Combines single-source shortest paths with a threshold sweep over costs;useful practice beyond returning one distance array.
body.learningObjective: Combines single-source shortest paths with a threshold sweep over costs;useful practice beyond returning one distance array.

body.title: Ball
body.ratingBasis: Optimizing a final survivor with partly fixed initial positions needs non-obvious process compression and feasibility reasoning;rough CF2800.
body.priorityReason: Interesting threshold reasoning through repeated median-like elimination,but the unusual queue process makes it specialized enrichment.
body.learningObjective: Interesting threshold reasoning through repeated median-like elimination,but the unusual queue process makes it specialized enrichment.

body.title: Oranges
body.ratingBasis: Bounded final-group length permits direct DP with incremental extrema;rough CF1600.
body.priorityReason: A friendly partition-DP exercise:extend the last box while updating its minimum and maximum.
body.learningObjective: A friendly partition-DP exercise:extend the last box while updating its minimum and maximum.

body.title: Collecting Stamps 2
body.ratingBasis: Maximizing JOI triples after one insertion needs several reusable counts and 64-bit arithmetic;rough CF1800.
body.priorityReason: Teaches prefix/suffix subsequence counts and separating the contribution of one inserted character.
body.learningObjective: Teaches prefix/suffix subsequence counts and separating the contribution of one inserted character.

body.title: Train Fare
body.ratingBasis: Many edge price increases make repeated shortest paths too costly;preserving original-distance reachability is the key modelling challenge;rough CF2400.
body.priorityReason: Uses the original shortest-path layers to reason about monotone fare changes;valuable after BFS and offline processing.
body.learningObjective: Uses the original shortest-path layers to reason about monotone fare changes;valuable after BFS and offline processing.

body.title: Territory
body.ratingBasis: Huge repetition count rules out direct simulation and requires grouping translated point occurrences and square conditions;rough CF3000.
body.priorityReason: Develops translation invariants for an extremely long repeated walk;specialized geometry enrichment rather than core simulation.
body.learningObjective: Develops translation invariants for an extremely long repeated walk;specialized geometry enrichment rather than core simulation.

body.title: Foehn Phenomena
body.ratingBasis: Track a piecewise contribution of each height difference and update endpoints carefully;rough CF1500.
body.priorityReason: An excellent example where a range update changes only two adjacent differences;strong preparation for more complex range problems.
body.learningObjective: An excellent example where a range update changes only two adjacent differences;strong preparation for more complex range problems.

body.title: Semiexpress
body.ratingBasis: Choosing extra stops across express intervals under a time budget needs arithmetic batching and greedy gain selection;rough CF2500.
body.priorityReason: Teaches allocation by marginal gains across independent line segments with a very large implicit coordinate range.
body.learningObjective: Teaches allocation by marginal gains across independent line segments with a very large implicit coordinate range.

body.title: Kingdom of JOIOI
body.ratingBasis: Connectivity and row/column contiguity constrain possible cuts;turning spread minimization into an efficient check is nontrivial;rough CF2600.
body.priorityReason: A good advanced decision-problem transformation with monotone grid boundaries and symmetry handling.
body.learningObjective: A good advanced decision-problem transformation with monotone grid boundaries and symmetry handling.

body.title: Soccer
body.ratingBasis: Several action modes and long-distance kicks need compact state modelling before Dijkstra is practical;rough CF2800.
body.priorityReason: Teaches expanded shortest-path states by separating carrying,motion and kicking modes instead of tracking every player configuration.
body.learningObjective: Teaches expanded shortest-path states by separating carrying,motion and kicking modes instead of tracking every player configuration.

body.title: Stove
body.ratingBasis: Sorting gaps and selecting the largest savings is one core observation;rough CF1200.
body.priorityReason: A clean introductory greedy problem:decide which idle gaps are worth separating with a limited number of activations.
body.learningObjective: A clean introductory greedy problem:decide which idle gaps are worth separating with a limited number of activations.

body.title: Art Exhibition
body.ratingBasis: Positive values justify filling gaps after sorting,then an algebraic sweep removes quadratic enumeration;rough CF1700.
body.priorityReason: Turns a subset objective with a size-range penalty into a sorted interval and running best prefix expression.
body.learningObjective: Turns a subset objective with a size-range penalty into a sorted interval and running best prefix expression.

body.title: Dango Maker
body.ratingBasis: Recognizing diagonal conflict structure rather than using generic grid matching is the principal insight;rough CF2400.
body.priorityReason: Shows how an apparently two-dimensional packing conflict can be decomposed into narrow dependencies for DP.
body.learningObjective: Shows how an apparently two-dimensional packing conflict can be decomposed into narrow dependencies for DP.

body.title: Snake Escaping
body.ratingBasis: Wildcard queries at million-query scale and a tight memory limit require combining subset/superset sums with small-side enumeration;rough CF2900.
body.priorityReason: A useful advanced subset-transform problem that rewards choosing among complementary query representations.
body.learningObjective: A useful advanced subset-transform problem that rewards choosing among complementary query representations.

body.title: Bitaro the Brave
body.ratingBasis: For each anchor,multiply rightward and downward counts while scanning the grid;rough CF1400.
body.priorityReason: Accessible grid counting with independent row/column choices;good practice replacing nested enumeration with suffix counts.
body.learningObjective: Accessible grid counting with independent row/column choices;good practice replacing nested enumeration with suffix counts.

body.title: Exhibition
body.ratingBasis: Sorting values and allocating frame capacities must preserve extendibility,not just fit each picture independently;rough CF2100.
body.priorityReason: Practices matching ordered resources to items while respecting two monotone criteria;useful after simpler frame/item greedy tasks.
body.learningObjective: Practices matching ordered resources to items while respecting two monotone criteria;useful after simpler frame/item greedy tasks.

body.title: Growing Vegetables is Fun 3
body.ratingBasis: Three color counts plus last color and movement costs form a larger DP than ordinary string rearrangement;rough CF2500.
body.priorityReason: Connects stable ordering of equal symbols,adjacent-swap cost and count-based sequence-building DP.
body.learningObjective: Connects stable ordering of equal symbols,adjacent-swap cost and count-based sequence-building DP.

body.title: Unique Cities
body.ratingBasis: All-root unique-distance layers plus distinct product types at large tree size demand strong structural reductions;rough CF3300.
body.priorityReason: Offers advanced tree-distance uniqueness and distinct-color aggregation;useful enrichment after standard rerooting and diameter work.
body.learningObjective: Offers advanced tree-distance uniqueness and distinct-color aggregation;useful enrichment after standard rerooting and diameter work.
